notes: Generated by the worktree's own api.services.breadth_symbols.build_breadth_bars (with the observed-OHLC mark) against a scratch COPY of the production web breadth_daily_ohlc store snapshot (2026-09-15). Read-only.

Authority = V1 in this snapshot. In production UCT is on BREADTH_AUTHORITY=v2: sessions 2026-03-23.. come from the frozen V2c2 artifact (35 V2_METRICS, sources intraday_recon_1m = observed, intraday_recon_1m_body = body) and validated live publications. The mark follows each row's own V2 source; that period is NOT in this snapshot and must be verified on production after deploy.

Collector-only metrics (UCTXR, UCTX, UCTAD, UCTEW, UCTSC, UCTFG, UCTPC, UCTAAII) show 0 bars here because the snapshot carries no collector history; in production they are collector EOD values with close-to-close bodies => SCALAR.
US universe: every row is close_recon (bodies) => SCALAR while BREADTH_AUTHORITY_US=v1. Under US V2 the 1-minute rows would mark automatically.
Market-indicator breadth-derived series (US:MCO/MCS/AD/ZBT) are recomputed scalars (family INDICATOR) => SCALAR, unchanged.
